components.name: Symmetric contact action-family gcd quotient
components.project_addition: For E001 Boolean contact Contact_d(x) iff x<d under a finite symmetric action language containing both +/-a_j gap moves with lower clipping at zero, prove that the exact coarsest arbitrary-future predictive state is K=ceil((d-x)/g), where g=gcd(a_j). Every action has exact integer quotient transport, non-top fibers have width g, distinct K-values are finitely behaviorally distinguishable using symmetric Bezout action words, and a generic predictive-partition compiler reconstructs the same K-fibers state by state on finite validation worlds. Explicitly record that asymmetric action semigroups or richer rebound/material languages can require different refinements.
